settings.name: easypost_api_key
settings.description: EasyPost API key (a test key to try it, a production key for real rates). Encrypted at rest and never sent to a browser

settings.name: easypost_services
settings.description: The services offered to customers, as carrier:service pairs separated by commas, using EasyPost's names. Only carriers on your EasyPost account return rates

settings.name: easypost_other_services
settings.description: Whether to also offer any other service EasyPost returns (other carriers, and services not in the list above)

settings.name: easypost_residential
settings.description: Whether orders are priced as going to a home, which carriers charge a surcharge for. Turn off if you mostly ship to businesses

settings.name: easypost_cache_minutes
settings.description: How long a price from EasyPost is reused for the same route, weight and size. Keeps checkout fast and keeps the number of rate requests (which EasyPost can charge for) down
